subject: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for production dataset 'mendo-clinic'
messages:
From: Elsa Moreno <elsa@medohealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medohealth.com
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for production dataset 'mendo-clinic'

Hannah —

We need to initiate a full purge of all prompts, model outputs, and the associated inference logs for our production dataset 'mendo-clinic' (customer ids: MENDO-CLINIC-2023). This is part of a compliance-driven exit we agreed to with our data subject erasure policy.

Scope we require:
- All prompt payloads and assistant outputs (including intermediate prompt fragments) linked to MENDO-CLINIC-2023 across the last 24 months.
- Inference request/response traces and audit logs that could reconstruct content.
- Any cached KV entries/prefix caches used by the model serving pipeline for that account.

Constraints:
- We need evidence of deletion (hash lists + time-stamped audit export).
- Preferred purge window: 2025-09-27 to 2025-09-30 (overnight ops).
- We will require a signed attestation from Redwood once completed.

Please confirm scope, estimated timeline, and whether Redwood needs anything signed or a PO to proceed. Attaching our internal purge scope form for your intake.

Thanks —
Elsa Moreno
Head of Compliance
MedoHealth
Attachment: mendo_purge_scope_form.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elsa Moreno <elsa@medohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for production dataset 'mendo-clinic'

Elsa —

Thanks for the clear scope and the form — received. We can execute the purge within your preferred window. High-level plan and next steps:

1) Intake & scope confirmation (today) — confirm dataset IDs and any excluded subfolders.
2) Pre-execution snapshot (read-only) for forensic purposes (we keep the snapshot internally for 30 days, then destroy; we'll provide a hashed manifest).
3) Scheduled execution (ops run) during your window — freeze writes, drain in-flight requests, purge prompt storage, expire/zeroize KV caches, sweep request/response trace logs, and rotate any related audit log shards.
4) Evidence delivery — timestamped CSV audit_export, signed attestation, and screenshots of successful purge.

Questions for you:
- Please confirm that MENDO-CLINIC-2023 is the full account scope (no sibling test accounts).
- Can MedoHealth sign the attached simple purge acceptance (we can DocuSign)?

I’ve looped in Marissa (Ops) for execution details and Priyom (Security) for evidence format. We’ll produce a runbook and a final attestation.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elsa Moreno <elsa@medohealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for production dataset 'mendo-clinic' — Execution runbook + timeline

Hi Elsa / team —

Per Hannah's note, below is the operational checklist we will follow. I’ve attached a formal runbook (erase_runbook_mendo_v1.2.pdf) with step-by-step commands and rollback preconditions.

Planned execution window: 2025-09-27 22:00 PDT -> 2025-09-28 04:00 PDT (estimated 4-6 hours).

Execution checklist (high level):
- Pre-run: record system state, create immutable snapshot for internal short-term forensic hold (manifest generated).
- Freeze & drain: apply temporary routing rule to stop writes to mendo-clinic models; wait for in-flight tokens to finish.
- Storage purge: remove entries from prompt_store and output_store filtered by tag MENDO-CLINIC-2023. Objects will be soft-deleted followed by irrevocable expunge pass.
- KV/prefix cache: trigger cache invalidation across serving nodes and overwrite KV shards tied to account namespace.
- Trace/log sweep: scan tracing buckets and redact/expunge any traces containing account identifiers; maintain a deletion log for transparency.
- Audit evidence: generate audit_export_2025-09-28.csv (timestamp, object key, operation performed, operator id, SHA256 of deleted artifact manifest).
- Attestation: after completion we will produce a signed attestation PDF and an internal run-complete log.

Security notes (for Priyom): we will use HSM-backed key zeroization for any keys tied to the account and rotate access tokens for the serving pool.

Attachments: erase_runbook_mendo_v1.2.pdf (runbook), checklist_summary.txt (inline).

Please confirm acceptance of the timeline. If you need a narrower SLA window (e.g., 1-2 hours), tell us ASAP — that increases coordination complexity.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Engineer, Production Services
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elsa Moreno <elsa@medohealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Sep 2025 04:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Completed: purge for 'mendo-clinic' — evidence attached

Elsa / Hannah —

The purge run completed at 2025-09-28T03:42:18-07:00. Summary of outcomes:

- Prompt/store objects: 12,432 objects matched filter and were expunged.
- KV shards: namespace MENDO-CLINIC-2023 overwritten and invalidated across 6 serving clusters.
- Traces/logs: 4.1GB of trace files redacted and removed.
- Snapshot: pre-run snapshot hash (SHA256): 7b3f...c9a5 stored temporarily and will be destroyed on 2025-10-28 per our internal evidence retention policy.

Attached: audit_export_2025-09-28.csv (detailed manifest), screenshot-erasure-complete.png (ops console view). The attestation DocuSign envelope has been submitted — DOCUSIGN: Envelope 0a9f-erase-2025-mendo. Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bMendoEraseEvidence

Operational notes:
- No errors that required rollback were observed. Two transient worker restarts occurred (nodes 7 and 12) and were reconciled automatically by autoscale hooks.
- We registered operator id marissa_cole and operator ticket REDWOOD-ERASE-9821 in the manifest.

If you confirm receipt, we will close the ticket and trigger final attestation signing.

Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: audit_export_2025-09-28.csv; screenshot-erasure-complete.png
From: Elsa Moreno <elsa@medohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medohealth.com
Date: Sun, 28 Sep 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Completed: purge for 'mendo-clinic' — evidence attached

Marissa / Hannah —

Thanks — we confirmed the evidence folder and audit_export CSV. Legal will review the attestation and the DocuSign envelope; we expect to countersign today. Appreciated the clear runbook and the manifest format — that works for our auditors.

Please keep the temporary snapshot only until 2025-10-28 as stated; after countersign we’ll mark the case closed and request final confirmation that the snapshot was destroyed.

Closing note: great coordination from your ops team.

Best,
Elsa Moreno
Head of Compliance
MedoHealth
